# النخبة | Alnokhba Edu

> Arabic-first (Egyptian) education-center management SaaS for tutoring centers, academies, and private teachers in Egypt and MENA. One platform for students, groups, sessions, attendance, homework, exams and grades, WhatsApp parent reports, a QR student/parent portal, and weekly performance insights. Web app + mobile PWA, RTL, Egyptian Arabic UI (the app interface also supports English). Operated from Egypt.

## What the product does

- Manages the full daily workflow of an education center: students and groups, session pipeline (attendance → interaction → homework → exams → report), and parent communication.
- Attendance is recorded per student per session (tap-based and QR-based); homework and exam grades are tracked per session.
- WhatsApp reports for parents are generated automatically from real session data and sent through an organized send queue (no auto-billing, no spam).
- Students and parents get a private portal via a personal QR link showing their attendance, grades, and reports.
- Students absent from their group's last two held lectures are auto-archived (one-tap restore) — retroactive from day one.
- A weekly analytics review surfaces patterns that need action (accumulated absence, declining group performance).

## Pricing (monthly, EGP — verified 2026-10)

- Starter: 399 EGP/month — up to 300 active students.
- Growth: 799 EGP/month — up to 1,000 active students (most popular).
- Pro: 1,499 EGP/month — up to 3,000 active students.
- Enterprise: custom quote — 3,000+ students, multi-center chains (separate isolated accounts).
- Multi-branch management is on the roadmap (not yet in the product).
- Activation and renewal happen over WhatsApp after personal confirmation; there is no online payment and no automatic billing.

## Free trial

- 14 days with the full core product. No credit card required.
- After the trial the account is paused (not deleted); data is preserved indefinitely and renewal restores everything exactly as it was. Nothing is ever auto-deleted.
